purpose: Observed daytime comparison samples used to convert accepted Second Shift work into defensible interactive-turn and elapsed-chat counterfactuals.
rules: Record observed comparable daytime work; never backfill a sample from intuition.
Do not count assistant/tool calls as user_execution_turns.
A user execution turn is a user message needed to authorize, continue, redirect, adjudicate or request the next execution unit in the established interactive workflow.
Do not mix materially different complexity bands merely to reach the sample threshold.
Use median turns-per-VPU and median elapsed-chat-minutes-per-VPU for counterfactual estimates; report sample count and interquartile range.
Human attention savings remain UNKNOWN unless active_user_minutes are directly observed with enough comparable samples.
